clip_grad_norm_: clip the gradient norms of model parameters to a specified maximum value during training
get_activation_fn: get a callable activation function by name such as relu, gelu, tanh, or swish
move_to_cuda: move all tensors in a nested sample structure to a CUDA device with non-blocking transfer
make_positions: replace non-padding symbols in a tensor with their position numbers starting at padding_idx plus one
resolve_max_positions: resolve maximum position constraints from multiple sources by taking the minimum across dicts or tuples
